chunks: Sometimes I performed tawaf with Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام while he was holding my hand for two tawafs and three, then he would depart and pray six rakʿahs.

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, the Imam being accompanied in the tawaf
key_terms.الطَّوَافَيْنِ: two tawafs; two complete circumambulations sets
key_terms.طُفْتُ: I performed tawaf; circumambulated the Kaʿbah

ai.seo_question: Can multiple tawafs be performed before praying their rakʿahs?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates Zurārah’s observation of Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام combining two or three tawafs before performing six rakʿahs of prayer. It indicates a practical pattern in the rites of tawaf and the prayer associated with it.
